First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at @womenledcycling the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Women-Led Cycling Wednesday Night Ride group ride

A Wednesday night group ride out of the Waldo neighborhood, led by women and open to everyone. Listed by BikeWalkKC's Women Bike KC program as one of the metro's inclusive ride groups. Meet point and time go up on Instagram each week.
